# Lifespan timeline of prime ministers of Canada__disambig_1

This is a graphical lifespan timeline of prime ministers of Canada. Twenty-four people have served as the prime minister of Canada since the office came into existence in 1867. They are listed in order of office; prime ministers leading multiple ministries are listed in the order of their first premiership.
